{"command":"python3 - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN, getcontext
import csv, io
text='''record_id,quantity,unit_price,shipping
CUS-001,28,63.66,74
CUS-002,40,55.6,62
CUS-003,72,30.9,24
CUS-004,16,11.51,53
CUS-005,34,64.0,43
CUS-006,55,60.08,66
CUS-007,37,65.85,19
CUS-008,66,36.68,62
CUS-009,40,15.6,44
CUS-010,53,22.76,34
'''
d=Decimal('0.0837'); t=Decimal('0.0673'); cent=Decimal('0.01')
print('factor', (1-d)*(1+t))
tot=Decimal(0)
for row in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text)):
    raw=Decimal(row['quantity'])*Decimal(row['unit_price'])*(1-d)*(1+t)+Decimal(row['shipping'])
    rounded=raw.quantize(cent, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    tot += rounded
    print(row['record_id'], raw, rounded)
print('records',10,'total',tot, 'quantized total',tot.quantize(cent, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN))
PY"}
